design_lock.window_rule: deep physical segmental-arched black steel sash

research.title: The Legacy of the Sawtooth Roof
research.lesson: The steep glazed faces should turn away from direct sun and repeat as a complete structural daylighting system across a deep industrial plan.

research.title: Preservation Brief 13: Repair and Thermal Upgrading of Historic Steel Windows
research.lesson: Historic rolled-steel sash relies on very slender frames, many small panes, expressed perimeter putty lines and real wall depth rather than dark window decals.

research.title: Heritage Steel Windows
research.lesson: Contemporary heritage-compatible assemblies can keep the thin industrial profile while using thermally broken frames and physically plausible insulated glazing.
